item.title: Great Job, Internet!: A Melania-based erotic horror parody book is cleaning up on the Amazon charts
item.description: The free novel Melania: Devourer Of Men has taken over several Amazon charts, spurred on by protesters gaming the algorithm to mock Brett Ratner's new doc.

item.title: February games preview: Resident Evil's latest frights cap off a busy month
item.description: Find out what The A.V. Club will be playing next month in our February games preview. It might get pretty scary.

item.title: Inside the hideous, exploitative, and but still addictive world of vertical dramas
item.description: Every day, millions of Americans are paying vast sums of money to watch vertical dramas: absurd melodramatic movies, chopped into 70 pieces.

item.title: Fascist violence reaped domestic tragedy in The Medium
item.description: Before remaking Silent Hill 2, Bloober Team revealed fascism and abuse as two sides of the same coin in The Medium, which was released five years ago this week.

item.title: xAI is hiring the world's most overqualified "AI writing" babysitters
item.description: The Elon Musk AI company's job posting requires applicants sport things like "verified novel publishing deals" and "at least two produced feature films."
